name: ARCHIPELAGO
description: Decentralized learning for collaborative autonomous platforms: nodes learn locally and transfer validated capabilities peer to peer, with no central AI dependency.

usage.audience: Defense and autonomy first (UAV squadrons in contested, communications-constrained environments); the brand stays broad enough for search and rescue, robotics, disaster response and other edge systems.

dataPolicy: All demonstration data is illustrative. Experimental claims require measured results.

assets.mark: Original island-network logo traced from the supplied deck. Use public/assets/archipelago-logo.svg. Preserve island shapes, curved links, and five orange nodes.
assets.logoColorRule: The original logo uses source colors. The interface palette remains the canonical deck palette.

avoidNote: SUPERSEDES the earlier rule against military-specific imagery. Defense is the core theme and the hackathon track: UAV squadrons, contested-comms operational geography and mission-systems graphics are on-brand. Keep it technical and credible, not propaganda.
